name: amla-rts-tracker
display_name: AMLA RTS/ITS Tracker — Mandated Technical Standards
description: Structured knowledge graph tracking AMLA's mandated Regulatory Technical Standards (RTS) and Implementing Technical Standards (ITS) under AMLR 2024/1624 and AMLA Regulation 2024/1620. Covers RTS on risk factors, CDD, remote onboarding, beneficial ownership, group policies, EDD for HRTCs, correspondent banking, PEPs, transaction monitoring, SAR format, plus supervisory methodology ITS and lifecycle status tracking.
author: Futurechain FCP Team
